notes.title: Update 0.174a. Manage damage control teams dialog at any phase of the turn.

It can be opened by clicking the button in the “Crew” section of ship status panel in the upper right corner of the screen. It allows to disband, reassemble and replenish damage control teams.[img src="https://i.postimg.cc/C18g5qv4/Troubled-Waters-UI-2025-06-26-04-07-02-1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]The decrease in the efficiency of impaired damage control teams has been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]A couple of bugs have been fixed.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.17a. Damage control rework.
notes.notes: [p]Changelog:[/p][olist][*][p]The damage control system has been reworked. I wrote a detailed article about this on [url="https://www.indiedb.com/games/naval-hurricane/features/dev-blog-11-damage-control-redesign/"]Indie DB[/url].[/p][list][*][p]Added Damage control teams that can be assigned to repair modules, firefighting and holes patching. Damage control teams replaced the old priorities assignment system.[img src="https://i.postimg.cc/QVZGJYH4/damage-control-teams-assignment-window.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]The maximum priority of module maintenance tasks has been reduced to 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage log button has been added to UI screens of all ship parts that can be selected during the damage control phase.[/p][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/tgBbGzMJ/damage-log-window.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Added the UI window allowing to select a specific Compartments group or deck area if there were multiple compartment groups/deck areas under the mouse pointer when the player clicked.[/p][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/y8YBQ5Lt/ship-part-selection-window.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]On every ship, except civilian ships, additional compartments in the bow and stern were designated as counterfloodable.[/p][/*][*][p]Now, during the damage control phase, only those compartments that can be used in counterflooding are marked with color, and not the entire compartments group, as was the case previously.[/p][/*][*][p]Water pumping performance has been significantly increased.[/p][/*][*][p]The speed of module repair has been significantly reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]The speed of patching holes has been significantly increased.[/p][/*][*][p]The X-Ray view key command (default key "i") can now be used during the damage control phase to show the normal view of the ship.[/p][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/HWrfxMxJ/x-ray-view-to-normal-view-switch.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Updated tooltips for module repairing, fire-fighting, holes patching and water pumping tasks.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the water pumping capacity tooltip on the upper resources panel of damage control phase.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Several changes have been made to the damage model:[/p][list][*][p]The resistance of armor plates to structural damage has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased armor weakening effect from continuous hits. Armor thickness is now ignored in case if the hit position falls into a hole from a previous hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased structural damage from projectile hits.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced structural damage from fragments.[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly increased structural damage from underwater explosions.[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly increased the chance of magazine detonation from underwater explosions.[/p][/*][*][p]Chance of detonation of artillery and torpedo turrets from direct hits and blast waves has been slightly reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]The AP power of underwater explosions has been reduced, but the range of the blast wave has been increased.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Several visual effects updates have been made:[/p][list][*][p]The visual effect of the magazine detonation has been slightly changed.[/p][/*][*][p]Added fire particle effect for compartments with large portholes.[/p][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/fRjtX6JP/fire-inside-portholes.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Increased the maximum value of the “Smoke lifetime” slider in the Graphics tab of the Settings screen.[img src="https://i.postimg.cc/rsrzpHBQ/long-smoke-trails.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The critical trim angle has been reduced from 20 to 15 degrees.[/p][/*][*][p]The radius of the sun overbright effect has been greatly increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed support for 4:3 screen resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Projectile dispersion is now increased if the target is poorly visible.[/p][/*][*][p]The random distribution method for artillery projectiles dispersion has been changed from uniform to Gaussian.[/p][/*][*][p]The gong sound effect when firing artillery has been removed for all destroyers and light cruisers.[/p][/*][*][p]Added fog range tooltips to the handler and ‘Thinner’ and ‘Denser’ text labels of the Fog slider of Custom Battle main menu screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The content of Help window have been actualized.[/p][/*][*][p]Several performance improvements have been made.[/p][/*][*][p]A couple of minor UI changed have been made.[/p][/*][*][p]A lot of bugs have been fixed.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]The changes are really big this time, so please be patient with more bugs than usual.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.165a. New sounds of ship sinking.
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added a set of screech sounds of the hull of sinking ships.
[*] Barbette and casemate artillery turrets are now susceptible to soot as a result of fire, just like open deck mounts.
[*] Fire extinguishing in a compartment can now be performed even if the fire is so strong that the crew can’t be in the burning compartment, but can be in one of the adjacent compartments.
[*] Several bugs have been fixed.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.16a. Von der Tann battlecruiser and a more natural list and trim.
notes.notes:
A big update that is the result of long period of work to give a more natural list and trim behaviour to a partially submerged ship. The first German battlecruiser, Von der Tann, is also here.
Changelog:
[olist]
[*] Von der Tann class battlecruiser has been added for German Empire.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ujSQPnl.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fz70Zet.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DsMCEEu.png[/img]
[*] More physically based centers of mass of all ships have been set. This allows ships to sink after losing stability and makes their roll more natural.
[*] Battle AI changes:
[list]
[*] During artillery combat the AI can now gradually close the distance to enemies. It depends on the bravery of the AI commander and the power balance between the AI and its enemy.
[*] The AI can now switch firing side in artillery combat if the opposing side has significantly more working artillery or the artillery on the current side doesn’t have sufficient range due to ship inclination.
[/list]
[*] Changes in damage calculation:
[list]
[*] The chance of detonation of torpedo tubes and spare torpedoes has been slightly reduced for direct kinetic hits and significantly reduced for blast waves.
[*] Slightly reduced the slowdown of projectiles and debris inside ship compartments (they now lose speed less).
[*] Structural damage has been significantly reduced.
[*] Slightly increased the chance of fire from surface blast waves.
[*] Significantly reduced the chance of fire from underwater blast waves.
[*] Increased the effect of armor weakening from multiple hits in the same place.
[/list]
[*] UI/UX changes:
[list]
[*] “Counterflooding” button has been added to the damage control window for appropriate compartment groups.
[*] “Enable X-Ray view for enemy ships” checkbox has been added to the Difficulty tab of the Settings screen to enable X-Ray view hotkey when an enemy ship is selected. X-Ray view hotkey is now always enabled for all allied ships.
[*] “Display the status of enemy and allied ships in equal detail” checkbox has been added to the Difficulty tab of the Settings screen allowing detailed information about a selected enemy ship to be displayed in the upper right corner of the battle UI, just like it would be for a selected allied ship.
[*] “Smoke lifetime (longer smoke trails)” slider has been added to the Graphics tab of the Settings screen to control the length of smoke trails.
[*] Added the ability to select a sinking ship and switch the camera to it by mouse double clicking.
[*] The “Abort battle” option has been added to the battle escape menu, allowing you to interrupt the battle and display the report screen.
[/list]
[*] A couple of bugs have been fixed.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.153a. New weather and time of day options.
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] New weather and time of day options have been added.

[list]
[*] A "Fog" slider has been added to Custom Battle screen.
[*] Thunderstorm and cloudy weather have been added to the Weather selector of the Custom Battle screen.
[*] The Morning and Evening Time of Day options of the Custom Battle screen have been divided into early and late morning/evening.
[/list]
[*] An artillery fire gong has been added for main guns of all ships except armed merchants. "Artillery fire gong" checkbox has been added to the Audio tab of the Settings screen to disable this effect.
[*] The amount and duration of smoke of detonation particle effect has been slightly increased.
[*] Slightly reduced structural damage from surface explosions.
[*] A couple of minor UI changes have been made.
[*] A couple of bugs have been fixed.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.151a. Bug fixes.
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] A hotkey to focus the camera on the selected ship (“F” by default) has been added.
[*] A couple of bugs have been fixed.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.15a. Battle report UI.
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] "View report" button displaying "Battle Report" UI screen has been added to the UI showing the battle result.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0hjZAiv.png[/img]
[*] Free camera is now automatically activated along with the UI displaying the battle result.
[*] All ships can now surrender if their position is bad. The chance of warships surrendering is very low, while the chance of civilian ships surrendering is much higher.
[*] A lightly armed version (with a single aft turret) of the existing 8000 tons cargo ship has been added for both playable nations.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/URQYIZf.png[/img]
[*] “Use binocular view as projectiles tracking camera” checkbox has been added to Difficulty settings tab.

[*] A couple of bugs have been fixed.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.144a. Bugfixes for 0.143a and artillery accuracy adjustments.
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] The positive effect of the best fire control systems on projectile spread has been slightly reduced.
[*] The algorithm for generating random commanders has been changed to make their professional characteristics more equal.
[*] The calculation of the effect of ship pitching on artillery accuracy has been changed from per turn estimating of the ship model pitching in the 3D world to a constant value based on wind strength (Beaufort scale) and the type of the ship.
[*] Starting distance selection slider has been added to Custom Battle screen.
[*] Several bugs have been fixed.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.143a. Artillery accuracy reduction.
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Artillery accuracy has been significantly reduced.
[*] The effect on rough seas on artillery accuracy has been increased.
[*] The minimum and maximum values of “Projectile spread” slider of the Settings screen has been changed.
[*] Added the ability to choose between the tight shell pattern (default) and the loose shell pattern with double spread value.
[*] Special logic has been implemented for projectiles after they hit the water. Now they have a chance to shatter (greater velocity significantly increases this chance). All projectiles are also considered to tumble upon hitting water, causing their AP multiplier to gradually decrease to a value equal to the AP multiplier of the projectile fragments. Again, higher velocity means faster AP reduction.
[*] A couple of bugs have been fixed.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.141a. Hotseat mode and damage model tweaks.
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Hotseat mode (the ability to select both sides as human players) has been added.
[*] The difficulty, time of day and weather UI selectors of Custom Battle screen have been changed to save space in the UI.
[*] Several minor performance optimizations have been made.
[*] Several errors in the armor model of turrets of Bellerophon class dreadnought have been fixed.
[*] The following changes have been made to the calculation of structural damage:

[list]
[*] Structural damage caused by explosions has been reduced by 20%.
[*] Vulnerability to structural damage of all armor plates has been reduced. The effect of armor thickness on vulnerability to structural damage has been reduced.
[*] Torpedo bulkheads vulnerability to structural damage has been further reduced by 25%.
[*] A more stringent rule for selecting adjacent bulkheads for cascading structural damage to exclude more bulkheads faced approximately the same direction as the bulkhead or hull plate that suffered the initial structural damage.
[/list]
[*] For better simulation of explosions inside and outside the armored turrets, the following changes have been made:

[list]
[*] Turret guns were divided into two parts: the bore and the breech mechanism.
[*] To simulate the empty space between the turret and the barbette, virtual armor plates made of “air” material have been added on top of all barbettes that have armored caps. When calculating damage, these plates have higher priority than the plating of the corresponding barbette compartment (just like regular armor plates).
[/list]
[*] Flooding rate has been reduced by 30%.
[*] A couple of bugs have been fixed.
[/olist]

[*] A 'Difficulty' tab has been added to the Settings screen with two settings:
[list]

[*] A slider that allows you to adjust the spread of projectiles.
[/list]
[*] An artillery turret can now be damaged (considered jammed) even if its armor has not been pierced.
[*] Changes of ship models:
[list]
[*] The length of torpedo bulkheads of SMS Blücher (Patreon reward ship) has been significantly reduced to cover only compartments near and between the main battery forward and rear centerline gun turrets.
[*] The compartments structure of SMS Blücher (Patreon reward ship) has been slightly modified to have a larger torpedo compartment near the main battery bow turret.
[*] Most of side cofferdam compartments of Scharnhorst class model have been merged with adjacent coal bunker compartments, as is made on other ships in the game.
[*] Compartments structure of Scharnhorst class model has been slightly modified to have an appropriate torpedo tube compartment located near the main battery bow turret.
[/list]
[*] A couple of minor UI changes have been made.
[*] A couple of bugs have been fixed.
[/olist]

[list]

notes.title: Version 0.103a. Preemptive holes patching
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Preemptive holes patching has been added. Holes can now be patched even if they haven't caused floods yet.
[*] The mechanics of estimating the distance delta between ships, which is used by the AI, have been slightly changed. Distance estimation error now decreases slightly with each turn as ships get closer or farther away.
[*] The buoyancy calculation method in the main menu scene has been changed to a faster one (the same as used in the battle 3D scene).
[*] ‘Underwater blur’ slider has been added to the Settings UI.
[*] Increased the maximum zoom out distance and the default zoom out distance for the camera that follows projectile salvos.
[*] In case of a miss, the waiting interval has been increased before switching from the camera following salvos to the ship's camera.
[*] The minimum problem level and the minimum module damage, which were previously marked in green, are now marked in yellow.
[*] The number of crew members required to patch holes has been significantly reduced.
[*] A couple of bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.099a. Various changes and fixes
notes.notes:

[*] Minor changes in the logic of the save and load UI screens, including checking of the save file for compatibility with the game version.

[list]

AI artillery fire accuracy should now suffer more from changes in distance between ships.[/list][*] The game is now actively plays with centers of mass of ships after they are declared sinking. notes.title: Early Access Release Announcement
notes.notes:
The Steam Early Access launch date has been selected. It's November 16th.

[previewyoutube=kYWsPCAuRiw;full][/previewyoutube]
Although there is a ton of work to bring the game to its final state as I see it, it already feels playable and not too full of bugs. The people on my Patreon have given a lot of great tips to improve the game. And it is time to get even more feedback from the players to fine-tune my vision of the end result.
